description: Honest external-stream handling on Vidaa: upstream keeps externalUrl streams visible on Vidaa but gates the press to a dead-end dialog ('Opening other apps is not currently possible...'). This edit removes Vidaa from that gate so Vidaa gets the SAME flow the Web platform gets: the bilingual confirm dialog ('You are about to exit Stremio and open <app>') and then openExternal -> window.open(url) — the streaming service's website in the TV browser. No fabricated deep-link hooks (VIDAA firmware does not honor fabricated platform messages — issues #28/#29 precedent); the popup-blocked case is caught by player/external-streams.js.

ops.note: External stream press: Vidaa joins the confirm-dialog branch instead of the dead-end dialog (isTitan/isNetTV keep the dead-end).
